name: Out-year / MyCAP multi-year COLA inert (design drift)
what_it_tests: The spreadsheet model specifies multi-year compounding Y2/Y3 COLA totals, but the live Final_Year_COLA_Calculated_Price__c formula is broken and never feeds pricing; single-year per spec is the agreed scope
proc_mechanism: Formula field Final_Year_COLA_Calculated_Price__c computes but has zero references in the procedure; branches use wrong bases + PricingTermCount exponent without unit guard
expected_behavior: Either wire Final_Year prices into the procedure for Y2/Y3 billing, or confirm out-year stays flat (single-year per spec, agreed out-of-scope)
test_setup: Multi-year renewal (3-year term), COLA active, check whether Y2/Y3 reflected in line total
